LIGO Scientific Collaboration, Virgo Collaboration and KAGRA Collaboration Data Releases
Published July 17, 2026 | Version v1
Dataset Open

Posterior sample release for GWTC-4.0: Tests of General Relativity. II. Parameterized Tests

Authors/Creators

  • LIGO Scientific Collaboration
  • Virgo Collaboration
  • KAGRA Collaboration

Description

This contains the full posterior sample release for the analyses in the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA paper GWTC-4.0: Tests of General Relativity. II. Parameterized Tests:

  • FTI test of GW generation (Section 2.1): FTI.zip
  • TIGER test of GW generation (Section 2.1): TIGER.zip
  • Multiparameter test of GW generation with PCA (Section 2.2): PCA.zip
  • Spin-induced multipole moment null test using a Phenom waveform model (Section 2.3): SIM-Phenom.zip
  • Spin-induced multipole moment null test using an EOB waveform model (Section 2.3): SIM-EOB.zip
  • Line-of-sight acceleration (Section 2.4): LOSA.zip
  • Test of a modified GW dispersion relation (Section 3.1): MDR.zip
  • Test of anisotropic birefrengence from the Standard Model Extension (Section 3.2): SSB.zip

Each zip file contains HDF5 files that can either be read directly with standard HDF5 tools or using PESummary. The curated data set used for producing the figures and table in the paper can be found here.
